name: community-deprivation-index
description: This data provides the Community Deprivation Index (CDI) Scores for all block groups in the nation.
longDescription:
This data provides the Community Deprivation Index (CDI) Scores for all block groups in the nation with the following fields:

 FIPS_CHAR: 13-character FIPS code for a given block group. Can be broken into codes for state (digits 1-2), county (digits 3-5), tract (digits 6-11), and block group (digit 12), prefixed by "G". CDI_NATRANK: Nationally ranked relative index score. Ranges from 1-100. Due to the unreliability of their data, certain block groups are suppressed with either GQ, PH, or GQ-PH.

 Suppression flags: GQ: High group quarters population PH: Low population and/or housing
